title: Single-site coefficient factor in the balanced tensor reassociation
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l and an inclusion ι, a scheme W, an index e, quotient maps j, normalized Coefficients data on W [def-weil-ramified-pullback-tower-data], and n. Put R=completed E coefficients, S=completed L coefficients, B=finite E coefficients at n, T=finite L coefficients at index(e,n). For every B-module sheaf N on this single site, extension along R→S of N restricted along R→B is isomorphic to restriction along S→T of extension along B→T of N. On section tensors the isomorphism sends s tensor x to π_L(s) tensor x. No scheme morphism, reduction of N, or geometric pullback occurs.

The sheafification unit gives pure tensors, their naturality, and scalar multiplication on their first factor. The normalized extension/restriction adjunction shows that maps out of scalar extension are determined by unit tensors. These identities are proved as private helpers and then transported back through the specified scalar object equalities.

proof.text: The completed projections p:R→B and q:S→T are surjective on sections: a finite constant quotient map is sectionwise surjective, since its underlying set map has a section and constant sheafification commutes with underlying sets; the constant quotient map factors through completion by the limit-lift projection identity. Lean reuses the proved private constantQuotient_surjective helper from CompletedIntegralFiniteQuotientHomExt for the first assertion.

proof.text: Let z be a local section of ker(q). The supplied coefficient isomorphism and its normalization send the image of z tensor 1 to zero. Its injectivity implies that this tensor has zero image in the coefficient tensor sheaf. Local injectivity of the sheafification unit makes z tensor 1 zero locally in the raw tensor. For a B-module section x, apply the sectionwise contraction s tensor b ↦ s tensor (b x) to obtain z tensor x = 0 locally, hence in the module tensor sheaf. Local surjectivity of the sheafification unit and tensor induction show that z annihilates every section of S tensor_R Res_p N.

proof.text: Descend the S-action on P=S tensor_R Res_p N through the surjective q using the ring homomorphism into additive endomorphisms and kernel annihilation, obtaining a T-module D with the same underlying abelian sheaf. The identity q(s)x=sx proves restriction compatibility, so D is a sheaf of T-modules. The projection p is surjective, so the unit N→P is B-linear with target D restricted along j: lift a B scalar to R and use cq=pj. Extension along j gives T tensor_B N→D. The j-extension unit, restricted to R, gives P→Res_q(T tensor_B N) by the c-adjunction. Unit tensor calculations show the maps inverse. For the second composite, surjectivity of q upgrades restricted S-linear maps to T-linear maps, after which unit tensor extensionality applies. The forward map sends s tensor x to q(s) tensor x. Finally transport this isomorphism through the scalar object equalities. Every construction and identity is proved in Lean; no new statement is left unproved.

theorem coefficientModuleBaseChange_exists (W : Scheme.{t})
    (e : ℕ)
    (j : ∀ n : ℕ, Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1) →+*
      Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (index e n + 1))
    (data : Coefficients l E L ι e j W) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ b : ∀ N : Mod.{t, u} (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W n),
      (scalar.{t, u} data.completedMap).obj
          ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{max u (t + 1)}
            ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).map
              (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E W n))).obj N) ≅
        (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{max u (t + 1)}
          ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).map
            (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l L W (index e n)))).obj
          ((scalar.{t, u} (ramifiedMap l E L W e n (j n))).obj N),
      ∀ (N : Mod.{t, u} (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W n))
        (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (s : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L W).obj.obj U)
        (x : N.val.obj U),
        (b N).hom.val.app U
          (tensor.{t, u} data.completedMap
            ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{max u (t + 1)}
              ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).map
                (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E W n))).obj N) U s x) =
          @id (((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{max u (t + 1)}
            ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).map
              (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l L W (index e n)))).obj
                ((scalar.{t, u} (ramifiedMap l E L W e n (j n))).obj N)).val.obj U)
            (tensor.{t, u} (ramifiedMap l E L W e n (j n)) N U
              ((completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l L W (index e n)).hom.app U s)
              x)
